hypothesis: A causal RPP-confirmed support/resistance interaction may become more directionally useful when contemporaneous unweighted NIFTY constituent breadth and exact-clock NIFTY momentum independently agree with the RPP interaction direction.

context_contract.constituent_return: exact same-session T / T-5m log return
context_contract.breadth: unweighted mean sign of valid constituent 5-minute returns
context_contract.dispersion: recorded diagnostic only; not a gate

threshold_provenance.breadth_abs_min: Inherited from the pre-existing constituent lead-lag proxy freeze (0.40), not chosen from RPP outcomes.
threshold_provenance.minimum_constituent_count: 40 = 80% of NIFTY50, aligned with the pre-existing 0.80 constituent-coverage requirement.
threshold_provenance.rpp_minimum_relative_density: Inherited from the pre-physical RPP V2 freeze.
threshold_provenance.context_lookback_minutes: Exact 5-clock-minute constituent/index return, matching the independently specified constituent-direction campaign rather than the RPP outcome diagnostics.
